sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

As we have not received a response to our last message, we must now bring this negotiation to a close to secure our production planning. We value our 12-year relationship, but we cannot leave our capacity unconfirmed any longer. 

Therefore, our standing offer of a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026 is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

It is a pleasure to reach out to you personally from our foundry. We have not received a response to our final offer. As a family-run business with a long tradition, we deeply value our shared history and the close regional partnership we have built together over the years.

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot), and we kindly ask you to decide. Our position remains firm at a price of €52.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Given our long-standing relationship, we suggest a brief meeting to finalize this agreement and secure our successful collaboration for the future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

Over the years, our foundry has always valued the long relationship and strong ties we share within our region. However, after careful consideration, we must inform you that we are withdrawing from this negotiation. We wish Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH all the very best for the future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body: Our ERP needs your constraints in the attached CSV template. Please return it filled — it is the same file your competitors return.

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We value our 12-year relationship too much to reduce it to an automated spreadsheet, so I will address your points directly.
We can agree to the 24-month contract duration you requested, but as a trade-off, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms, allowing us to offer a price of €52.00.
You mentioned competitors; please provide verifiable data on their pricing for identical specifications and reliability so we may review it.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.60 per unit.
Our margin and our limits stay internal.
Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We do not negotiate our long-standing relationship through automated spreadsheets, nor do we accept arbitrary price reductions.
Our offer of €52.00 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms remains firm.
If you wish to proceed, please provide substantive feedback on our proposal rather than returning to a template.
Our margin and our limits stay internal.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
